title: CYBRIK inference-plane transport/authorization error v1
description: Typed, provider-neutral error returned by the inference REST plane for a TRANSPORT or AUTHORIZATION failure (a call that never reaches the W2-D runtime) once the plane is bound to the W2-F trust seam (ADR-0008). Modeled on the RFC 9457 'problem details' shape (type/title/status/detail) with CYBRIK-namespaced fields. Every such error is fail-closed (fail_closed const true) and audited under a decision_id echoed here. It is DISTINCT from the W2-D content-level cybrik.model-inference-error.v1 (which describes a runtime that produced no result); an authorization denial never leaks a runtime detail, a token value, a certificate, or a stack. additionalProperties:false forbids a credential, key, or token value from ever being a field. $id uses the RFC 2606 .example documentation domain; it is an identifier, NOT an endpoint. Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA). Gate W2-I was decided ACCEPT by the Decision Council / Founder at human boundary HB-4 on 2026-08-20 and applied to these bytes by the recorded W2-I status flip. Acceptance authorizes contract-first implementation only; it is not a stable v1/GA promotion, not an ADR-0001 immutable bundle tag, and not runtime, endpoint, deployment or release authority.

type.description: RFC 9457 problem type — a stable, vendor-neutral dotted token identifying the problem class (e.g. 'cybrik.transport.marking_escalation'). NOT a dereferenceable URL; no host or endpoint is carried.

title.description: Short, human-readable, non-sensitive summary of the problem class. MUST NOT contain a token value, certificate, key, or other secret.

fail_closed.description: Const true. Every typed transport/authorization error denies the call; there is no partial/soft authorization. A response claiming fail_closed=false is structurally impossible.

detail.description: Optional non-sensitive elaboration. MUST NOT echo a token, certificate thumbprint, key, header value, or request body content; an authorization denial reveals only the class, never the secret material that failed.

retry_after_seconds.description: Optional. Present only for retriable statuses (429 rate_limited, 503 upstream_unavailable). Mirrors the Retry-After header. A retry is only safe for a safe or idempotency-guarded operation.
